name: xlsx
description: Excel workbooks (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx): every sheet drawn in place — formatted values, fonts, fills, borders, merged cells — with sheet tabs and zoom.

suggestions.label: Explain this workbook
suggestions.prompt: Explain what this workbook contains and how its sheets relate. Do not change the file.

suggestions.label: Check the formulas
suggestions.prompt: Check the formulas and totals for errors or inconsistencies, fix them, and list what you changed.

suggestions.label: Tidy the formatting
suggestions.prompt: Make number formats, column widths and header styles consistent across the sheets. Keep every value.

suggestions.label: Add a summary
suggestions.prompt: Add a summary of the key figures (totals, averages, changes) where it fits best, using formulas.
